normalizationRule: numeric zero -> +0; every other value unchanged recursively; no list reordering, omission, tolerance, rounding or coercion
profileOrder: onset-major/frame-minor, exact frozen V21 roster; control excluded from 19 challengers
physicalSupport: every expected pitch is in frozen physicalTruth
targetViewKey: physicalUnitKey plus normalized expected target; no acoustic output in denominator
classDefinition: stored product verdict MATCH/RETRY/MISMATCH/null crossed with independently recomputed physical support; no new product verdict
metrics: raw assembled excess proposals as diagnostics only
unsupportedCoverageGate: candidate unsupported-covered identities subset baseline, and count not above baseline
recallGate: no supported MISMATCH, no supported NO_ATTEMPT, all supported views contain every expected pitch
meaningful: eligible AND >=2 paired recovered physical gestures from >=2 recordings; same target recovered at both 44100/48000 before deduplicating gestures
rankingComponents: negative Manhattan grid-index distance from control
rankingDirection: lexicographic descending; meaningful challengers only; stable complete ties yield no unique selection
comparison: exact recursive structural equality after signed-zero-only canonicalization; no omitted result fields
acousticDiagnostics: recount serialized Stage-A events/observations and arithmetic onset/frame summaries; no decoder; diagnostics do not rank
stop: any identity mismatch or remaining semantic mismatch: preserve partial verifier evidence and STOP, no result-driven edits or reevaluation
productVerdictAuthority: immutable serialized runtime records only; no runtime construction or product policy execution
